findings.claim: graveyard_enforced is green: '46 refutations loaded; probe naming peak-close was refused by G-01' — dead ideas are refused automatically.
findings.problem: The only evidence offered is one synthetic probe matched on a name string, while three arms currently marked [running/confirm] restate blocked graveyard entries: tp-7pct sets tp_pct=7.0 against G-24 (blocks 'tp7', 'tp=7', 'widen take profit'); sl-5pct moves sl_pct 3.0->5.0 against G-25 (blocks 'widen stop'); entry-8pct sets pump_pct=8.0 against G-08 (blocks 'pump>=8', 'raise pump threshold') and G-17. The checkbox demonstrates string matching on a probe, not that the running arena is clean of refuted ideas, and G-08 already recorded that a pump floor is a WR dial with flat EV that pays volume — which is what entry-8pct shows (screen_wr 51.417 vs control 49.903, screen_ev -0.075 vs control 0.029, screen_n 494 vs 1541).

findings.claim: All seven arms are reported as [running/confirm], and no_open_trades_scored is green with '26 trades still open; 0 of them leaked into a scored table'.
findings.problem: The two tables disagree about live trades. The arena reports live_n = 4/1/4/4/3/3/2 for control, entry-8pct, hold-12h, placebo, sl-5pct, tp-7pct, vol-4x; the paired_population check reports still-open counts of 4/1/4/4/5/5/3 for the same arms. For control, entry-8pct, hold-12h and placebo the live_n equals the open count exactly, which means those arms may have zero resolved live trades; for sl-5pct and tp-7pct the reported live_n is smaller than the number of trades stated to be open, which is impossible under either reading of live_n. Whichever convention is right, one of the two tables is wrong, and every arm is being carried in 'confirm' against a planned n=600 on live evidence that is at most a handful of trades and possibly none.

findings.claim: 'measured ghost arrival = 25.6 control trades/day' is presented as a measured quantity underwriting the confirm plan of n=600.
findings.problem: No n and no window are attached to this rate, in violation of the project's own 'report the n behind every statistic' rule. The live tier contains 25 events in total and control shows live_n=4, so the figure cannot have been measured on the live tape; it is consistent only with the backfill tier (4764 events, 61.0 days, control screen_n=1541). A backfill-derived arrival rate is being used to size and schedule a live confirm sample, which is exactly the tier-mixing the loop elsewhere forbids.

findings.claim: screen_dWR is the arena's paired headline: entry-8pct and vol-4x both report screen_dWR=0.0pp.
findings.problem: Both arms report a screen_wr level above control (51.417 on n=494 and 51.103 on n=861 versus control 49.903 on n=1541) while their paired delta is exactly 0.0pp, the same value the provably inert placebo returns (b=0, c=0). For arms whose entire mechanism is selection — dropping detections rather than changing the outcome of a taken trade — a paired delta over shared events is 0.0 by construction, so the primary metric cannot in principle detect the entry_trigger and liquidity_filter mechanisms these two arms were registered to test. They are accumulating toward n=600 under a statistic that is structurally blind to their claim, and the displayed screen_wr level difference is pure selection, not effect.

findings.claim: backfill_cannot_promote is green with 'Only live-tape evidence can promote — 0 surfaced arm(s); none promoted from a screen'.
findings.problem: The detail reports that nothing has been surfaced yet, which is a statement about the current empty state, not a demonstration that a backfill-derived result would be blocked from promoting. The check would return the same green with no gate implemented at all. Meanwhile every non-zero statistic in the arena (screen_n up to 1541, screen_wr, screen_ev, screen_dWR up to 5.26pp for sl-5pct) comes from the backfill tier of 4764 events, so the untested gate is the only thing standing between a backfill number and a promotion.

findings.claim: bonferroni_monotonic is green: 'Corrected bar counts every question asked — lifetime tests=6, pre-registered hypotheses=6; alpha=0.00833'.
findings.problem: The count of 6 does not reconcile with the loop's own record of questions asked. The graveyard lists G-01 through G-41 plus five retired arms, and one of those retirements, L-sl-entry-anchor, records an actual test result (paired p=9.18e-41 on n=1474, judged against alpha=0.01250). Four dedup arms were also registered and retired. The checkbox title asserts that every question asked is counted, but the number reported covers only the currently registered set, so the corrected bar of 0.00833 is not the bar the project's full test history implies.
